sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: Frontier Intelligence, Flash Cost - z.ai
sources.snippet: Before release, we tested GLM-5.3-Flash anonymously as ox-alpha on OpenCode and OpenRouter to gather user feedback. It quickly became the most popular model of the week — with all of this traffic served on Chinese AI chips.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: The model has a 1M context window and can now run locally via Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs with llama.cpp or Unsloth Desktop. GLM-5.3-Flash Guide GLM-5.3 Guide If you want to run GLM-5.3-Flash, please read our specific article for it. Dynamic 1-bit GGUF reaches ~76% top-1 accuracy while being 85% smaller.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: How to Run Locally - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: Run the new GLM-5.3-Flash aka ox-alpha model by Z.ai. GLM-5.3-Flash, also known as ox-alpha, is Z.ai's new 320B parameter (18B active) multimodal open model which outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world tasks at one-tenth the price. GLM-5.3-Flash also rivals Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT
sources.snippet: Model Overview GLM-5.3-Flash is the first native multimodal model in the GLM-5 series, delivering stronger intelligence than GLM-5.2 at an exceptionally low cost. Highly Efficient Hybrid Architecture GLM-5.3-Flash has 320B total parameters with 18B activated.
